meta.name: Sherley Farms — 50′ front-entry
meta.platSource: Sherley Farms Phase 1A/1B/1C Final Plats, Spiars Engineering & Surveying, 2026-10-29
meta.standardsSource: Pad Fit Exhibit, Sherley Farms Phase 1, Spiars Engineering & Surveying, Oct 2026, job 24-109, sheets 1-2
meta.addressSource: OCH address list, supplied by Brandi Williams 2026-11-09 (418 lots)
meta.geometrySource: POLYLINE_3D lot lines from the final-plat DWGs, polygonized; boundaries grouped into straight and curved runs
caveats: Preliminary in all aspects. Followed up with actual plot plans before moving forward. Sales and research tool only.
Lot coverage is not computed at this stage.
Front building lines are a developer/builder rule, stricter than PD zoning, and vary per lot. Rear, side and garage setbacks are PD zoning.
Porch may project 5 feet past the front BL and must stay 5 feet off the front property line. No AC space in the porch zone.
Sherley Farms is Anna. The Heights at Uptown is Celina. The two carry different rules and are never combined.

This file holds every 50-foot lot in the community, not only OCH’s. OCH builds 42 of the 167; DRB Homes builds 82 and Homebound 42. Draw them all and colour by the och flag — do not filter the file, the surrounding lots are the community context and monotony counts run along the street irrespective of builder.
openItems: The 16 Phase 1A fifty-foot lots that carry no front-BL tick on the plat are set to a 30 ft front building line on OCH’s instruction (Brandi Williams, 9 Nov 2026): C-11, D-10, D-11, E-5, E-6, E-8, E-13, F-2, F-3, F-7, F-12, G-3, G-4, G-9, H-5, H-6. The plat itself shows only 20 ft and 25 ft ticks in 1A, so this value is OCH’s and should be carried onto the plat at the next revision. Each lot records its own frontBL source.
Driveway restrictions from Pad Fit Exhibit sheet 1 (inlet conflicts, lot-12 driveway conflict, alley-entrance proximity) and the asterisked non-conforming lots are not yet extracted per lot.
Webber porch projection by elevation is not verified, so no porch credit is applied for Webber.

1B pad conflict, resolved to the plat. The 1B grading plan draws and labels a 40 x 85 pad, which OCH verified against the PDF on 9 Nov 2026. Measuring those same pads against the lot lines shows the grading plan seats them 5 ft FORWARD of the plat front building line on 60 of the 90 lots (plat 25 ft -> grading 20 ft on 34 lots, plat 30 ft -> grading 25 ft on 26 lots). The two documents are each internally consistent but describe different house positions, so the depth cannot be taken without the offset: on a 130 ft lot, a 30 ft front BL plus an 85 ft pad plus a 20 ft rear BL is 135 ft and does not close. The plat set (front BL tick plus 40 x 80) is published because the front BL is the enforceable builder rule; the grading figures ride along as padAlt. Spiars should reconcile the two.

Still to build for the driveway model: ROW width per street (measurable off the plat right-of-way lines), top-of-curb elevation at each lot driveway (grading plan spot elevations, now readable), and which side the driveway sits on per lot (Pad Fit Exhibit sheet 1).
meta.maxGradeSource: City of Anna, confirmed by OCH (Brandi Williams) 2026-11-09. Anna states a 12% maximum; no lower preferred figure is known, unlike Celina which prefers 10% and approves to 12%.
meta.slabSource: OCH standard, confirmed 2026-11-09. Top of slab sits 0.85 ft above finished pad; the garage apron sits 0.05 ft above finished pad. Verified on the model lot 1A F-7, 2417 Milam Street: plot plan TOS=685.05, PAD GRD=684.20, Apron=684.25, against FP=684.2 on the 1A grading plan.
meta.driveStartsAt: garage apron = FP + 0.05. The driveway runs from the apron to the top of curb; the 0.85 ft slab height does not enter the slope calculation.
meta.gradeElevationKey: On the grading plans, a spot elevation written 82.5F means 682.5 proposed finished. TC = top of curb, TW/BW = top/bottom of wall, FP = finished pad, GB = grade beam.
meta.sectionsSource: Sherley Farms Phase 1A Paving Typical Sections, Spiars Engineering & Surveying, sealed Colton L. Smith PE 146215, 3/20/2025 — released for interim review, not for construction.
meta.curb: 6 inch standard monolithic curb on all street sections. Parkway cross-slope 1/4 inch per foot (2%). Alleys carry an inverted crown — 3 inch invert on the 20 ft alley, 6 inch on the 28 ft — so a rear-entry apron slopes into the alley and the controlling elevation is the invert, not a pavement edge.
meta.driveRunNote: Garage face to back of curb = 25 ft garage setback + the parkway. At 12% this allows about 4.1 ft of fall on a 34.5 ft run.
meta.lotKeyNote: Block letters repeat between phases at Sherley (1B Block P and 1C Block P both exist), so the b field is phase-qualified — "1B P" — and the lot key is "1B P-1". The bare block letter is kept in blk.
meta.offersSource: OCH Sherley Farms 50′ plan line-up, supplied by Brandi Williams 2026-11-09: Campbell, Cooper, Crawford, Evelyn, Merritt, Renner, Shelby and Webber, each A/B/C. Listed here are only those the plan library can actually draw. Missing: Crawford, Evelyn and Merritt are not in plans.json at all; Campbell A and B are in the library with no width or depth; and the library carries Shelby D/E/F where OCH lists Shelby A/B/C, so no Shelby is offered until the elevation letters are reconciled.
meta.entryNote: Front entry. The rear line is a rear property line, not an alley.

meta.offersPendingNote: OCH states the full 50-foot line-up is Campbell, Cooper, Crawford, Evelyn, Merritt, Renner, Shelby and Webber, each A/B/C. Four of the eight families cannot be listed yet for the reasons above. They are recorded here rather than dropped, so the gap stays visible.
